title: EvolutionCraftPack
description: This modpack provides a vanilla-like game play experience with a handful of quality of life mods that improve performance and add some new features.
body:
The Evolution Craft modpack is focused on performance, exploration and immersion adding various quality of life features that will enhance your gameplay experience.

### Performance
This modpack includes many performance mods such as [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) and [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) that all contribute to smoother gameplay. [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) is also included but can be easily disabled if your pc can't handle it. To see all mods, select a version in the versions tab and scroll down.

### Exploration
World generation is completely overhauled in the overworld using [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith) and [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/mod/tectonic) which provide incredible mountains to explore and deep caves to discover.
[Dungeons and Taverns](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns) also adds a large variety of structures to find.

### Immersion
Using mods like [Ambient sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds), [sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound), [presence footsteps](https://modrinth.com/mod/presence-footsteps), [cool rain](https://modrinth.com/mod/coolrain) (very cool), and [first person model](https://modrinth.com/mod/first-person-model) you will be IMMENSELY IMMERSED... (maybe). shaders will also help. Oh, and you can also [do barrel rolls](https://modrinth.com/mod/do-a-barrel-roll) with your elytra.

### Quality of life
- want to see your saturation? [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) has got you sorted
- want to see ping more clearly? [Better Ping Display](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-ping-display-fabric) can do it well
- want to take a screen shot and paste it elsewhere? [ClipboardScreenshot](https://modrinth.com/mod/clipboardscreenshot) without doubt
- want to crawl through a tight space? [Crawl](https://modrinth.com/mod/crawl) is the perfect fit
- want to know who your locating? [Locator Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/locator-heads) Will help you find it
- want to search you stats? With [Search Stats](https://modrinth.com/mod/searchstats) you can
- want to know whats in a shulker box? [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip) will let you see
- want to see where you have gone? [Xaero's world map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) keeps it clean
